ArtworkFace.description: A face, as a disc no lettering may cover.

center.description: The face's centre, `[x, y]` in the picture's pixels, from its top left.
center.title: Center

radius.description: How far the face reaches, in pixels. Generous is safer than tight: no lettering overlaps this disc, and a tail stops on its edge.
radius.title: Radius

ArtworkFace.title: ArtworkFace

body.description: The figure's silhouette, a polygon in pixels, which a balloon pays to cover: half as much over its own speaker.
body.title: Body

face.description: The figure's face: a disc no balloon, caption or sound effect may cover.

mouth.description: Where the tail of a line the figure speaks ends, or the place a sound it makes comes from, in pixels. Left out, a tail aims at the face's centre.
mouth.title: Mouth

description: Everything the solver may know about a supplied picture's content.

figures.description: Each figure the picture draws, by the name a cast member's `figure` gives it. Every face here is kept clear of lettering, cast or not.
figures.title: Figures

keep_out.description: Regions lettering should stay off, each a polygon in pixels: a sign, a hand, what the panel is about. A cost, not a rule.
keep_out.title: Keep Out

size.description: The picture's size in pixels, `[width, height]`, as it was measured. It must be the picture's own.
size.title: Size
